description: Representation of real world phenomenon associated with a location relative to the Earth, such as cities, buildings, roads, rivers, forests and lakes.

collectionIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this specified geographical feature is a collection of features.

coordinateReferenceSystemId.description: The identifier of the coordinate reference system for this geographical feature.

description.description: The textual description of this specified geographical feature.

identifier.description: The identifier for this specified geographical feature.

includedCircle.description: A circle included in this specified geographical feature.

includedGeographicalGrid.description: The geographical grid included in this geographical feature.

includedGeographicalLine.description: The geographical line included in this geographical feature.

includedGeographicalMultiCurve.description: The geographical multi-curve included in this geographical feature.

includedGeographicalMultiPoint.description: The geographical multi-point included in this geographical feature.

includedGeographicalMultiSurface.description: The geographical multi-surface included in this geographical feature.

includedGeographicalPoint.description: The geographical point included in this geographical feature.

includedGeographicalSurface.description: The geographical surface included in this geographical feature.

includedPolygon.description: The polygon included in this geographical feature.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, of this specified geographical feature.

usedCoordinateReferenceSystem.description: The CS (Coordinate System) engineering coordinate reference system used for this specified geographical feature.

usedCoordinateSourceSystem.description: The geographical coordinate source system used for this specified geographical feature.
